info.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Admin Addresses Cart API
SAP Commerce Cloud List user carts

params.name: userId
params.description: User identifier. Use 'current' for the authenticated user or 'anonymous' for guest users.

params.name: fields
params.description: Response field configuration level. Use BASIC, DEFAULT, or FULL to control the amount of data returned.

items.docs: Retrieve all shopping carts for a specific user.

info.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Create a new cart

params.name: userId
params.description: User identifier. Use 'current' for the authenticated user or 'anonymous' for guest users.

params.name: oldCartId
params.description: Anonymous cart ID to merge

items.docs: Create a new shopping cart for the user. Can optionally merge an anonymous cart.

info.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Get cart details

params.description: User identifier. Use 'current' for the authenticated user or 'anonymous' for guest users.

params.name: cartId
params.description: Cart identifier

params.description: Response field configuration level. Use BASIC, DEFAULT, or FULL to control the amount of data returned.

items.docs: Retrieve details of a specific shopping cart.

info.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Delete a cart
